TEXT: [FI] On the day of Comiket.
[FI] Kirino and I met up with Kuroneko and Saori before going into the convention hall.
[FI] I basically spent the whole morning trying to stop Kirino and Kuroneko from quarreling and being struck by Kirino after discovering a bespectacled
[FI] maid's doujinshi, but well, it was fun, I guess.
[FI] And in the afternoon, we were supposed to meet in front of the stand to take part in the special event that Saori recommended.
[FI] ...is how it should have been, but...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Geez, where did the two of them go?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Now now, restrain thyself, Kyousuke-shi. The two of them probably had goods they each wanted to buy this afternoon.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] But, leaving Kuroneko aside, Kirino has just recovered her memories, so what should we do if she hits her head again in a place like this?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Hahaha, Kyousuke-shi really does care for his little sister.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hey, do you have any idea the trouble I went through during this whole incident? If I were to go through it again, I'd probably die of exhaustion.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] There's no need to worry, getting hit on the head won't result in memory loss like that.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] I asked an acquaintance in a hospital about it, and I learned that most causes of memory loss are either external or emotional injuries.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] For Kiririn-shi's case, the actual cause was probably due to stress.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Stress... Huh. That's a concept completely foreign to her.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] With all due respect, I do have an idea of what the cause of Kiririn-shi's stress might be.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What, tell me without giving off such an air of importance about it.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Huhu, Kiririn-shi's probably starved for love.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Huh?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] What was that? That word, which suits Kirino the least out of all the words in the entire world?
[FI] Love, love for who? Love for 2D little sisters?
[FI] Ahh... My head hurts just by thinking about these strange things...
[FI] Damn, that Saori... Making a :3 face again... She's definitely enjoying this!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Well then, the event is about to start, so let's go.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh? H-Hold on. Shouldn't we wait for Kirino and Kuroneko?!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] The two of them already went there ahead of us. Come, let's join them at the cosplay area!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] H-Hey! Don't push me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Woah! What's with this enthusiasm?!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Doesn't it look like everyone that attended Comiket today is gathered here? Say, Saori...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...She's not here?!
[FI] Crap... Did we get separated in the crowd?
[FI] ... There's too many people, it seems that it will be very difficult to find her.
[FI] Oh well, they're somewhere in this hall anyway. It feels lonely, but I'll just watch by myself.
[FI] ...But anyway, it's a really grand event.
[FI] The set is excessively extravagant... The specially-installed stage even has girls that looks like idols on it.
[FI] Furthermore, those girls look really high level. Could they be really popular idols?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Now that I think about it, I feel like I've seen them before...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh... Eeeeeeeeh!
[FI] Why are Kirino and Kuroneko both on this stage while surrounded by cheers, moreover when did Saori even get up there too!

SPEAKER: SPK_ANNOUNCER
TEXT: [FI] Everyone, thank you for waiting. The theme song unveiling event is about to start.

SPEAKER: SPK_ANNOUNCER
TEXT: [FI] The opening speech will be by Kiririn-san, who provided the theme song for this summer's Comic Circle Market!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Hello everyone, I'm Kiririn.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Thank you for letting me attend the unveiling event for this year. Umm... T-This... This...song...
[FI] Hey, hey, is she all right? She looks like she's struggling quite a bit, which is unusual for her.
[FI] Hmm? Seems like there are some whispers coming through the speakers...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hmph, getting all nervous over such a trivial thing. This is why commoners are nothing but headaches.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] S-Shut up! I have a sense of shame, unlike you.

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] That's right, Kuroneko-shi. Anyone would also be nervous confessing to the guy they like.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] This and that are two completely different things.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Oh my? I was certain you were here for a confession to a big brother...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Huh? Who would confess to that guy...!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That guy? Although I said a big brother, I didn't say it was YOUR big brother.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] W-W-Wha...!

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Now, now... both of you, please stop here.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...Tch.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hmph...
[FI] Hey, you guys, we can perfectly hear everything you're saying...
[FI] And Kuroneko, stop dragging me out as an example...
[FI] Oh! But it looks like Kirino's nervousness has calmed down now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] T-This song was created for the sake of an Onii-chan present here.
[FI] Heh, as expected from my little sister... Even that opening speech was well said...
[FI] However, it seems that she's glancing over in my direction a little...
[FI] Well, it's probably my imagination.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] For the one and only irreplaceable Onii-chan...
[FI] ...What?
[FI] An irreplaceable Onii-chan?  Kirino has another older brother?!
[FI] Wait, that's impossible...
[FI] ...So then, those words just now... Could it be...

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...I shall now start singing. Please listen carefully... Aniki①
[FI] As soon as the song started, the atmosphere around the stage reached its peak.
[FI] In the middle of the hall as a strange excitement and enthusiasm whirled around me, I managed to see it through the crowd of otaku.
[FI] The brilliant smile my sister gave as she winked at me, a smile that felt as if she was putting her entire being from this life... no, from even her previous life
[FI] and the next one into it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Good work. You did unexpectedly well there.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] T-That's obvious. I'm the one who was singing after all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah, yeah. You're right. Ah, by the way...

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] In the end, Kirino, why did you lose your memories?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Eh? Why are you asking about that now?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] No reason really, I just suddenly thought of it. So, what was the reason?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I-I remember at that time... I was chatting with the other two and then I suddenly got excited!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Hmm, what was it about? ......Ah!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I probably got too excited and slipped from the stairs while going to get some fruit juice, yeah!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Just what got you so excited that you fell from the stairs?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] T-That was... umm, that's right! I got all excited discussing about a new game～! Ah-ahahaha!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] You really are hopeless...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Hmph. Were we really discussing that?

SPEAKER: SPK_SAORI
TEXT: [FI] Ahh, so it's about that!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh? What are you talking about?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] ...! You two, stop right now! Don't say anything unnecessary!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] At that time... you were gleefully babbling about Senpai coming home the next day.

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Wha-! I-I never said such things!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Oh really. Then was the way you merrily talked about looking forward to the souvenir from his trip a hallucination?

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Guhhhh!! What's with you?! I already said I never said such things!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ouch?! Why did you kick me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Shut up!! I haven't gotten back that part of my memory, so I don't know anything!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] I don't know-!!!!!

SPEAKER: SPK_KIRINO
TEXT: [FI] Anything at all, okay!!!!!
[FI] ...I understand right now. What I feared most about Kirino losing her memories.
[FI] It was the fear that our sibling relationship would return to what it was before.
[FI] I didn't want her to lose only the memories of this past year where our sibling relationship got sliiightly better.
[FI] Looking at Kirino smiling with her friends, her face flushed red for some reason, with her memories recovered...
[FI] ...Suddenly, this came to mind:
[FI] 【My Little Sister Can't Be This Cute.】
